comment: HS mapping vs declaration: 3403.19 is CORRECT and covers the core line (engine, gear, fork, hydraulic, industrial oils, grease) — exact match for that part. 3824.90 is only PARTIALLY right: it is a residual basket code, whereas the site's distinct product lines have their own headings — coolant/radiator coolant belongs in 3820.00 (anti-freeze preparations), the additives line in 3811.90, and the base oil / bulk engine oil trade in 2710.19. Recommendation per Rule 3: keep the company, do not reject; correct the code set to 3403.19 + 3820.00 + 3811.90 + 2710.19, with 3824.99 retained only as a residual for speciality products. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' is broadly acceptable but imprecise — the actual activity is lubricant blending/chemical preparations (HS ch. 34/38), not oil & gas extraction; better label: 'lubricants & chemical preparations'. Trader signs noted: own factsheet lists 'Wholesaler Trader' as additional business and the company's origin is base-oil/additive resale — so a mixed manufacturer_trader profile is likely. Product lines MISSING from the declaration: coolant/anti-freeze (3820), additives (3811), base oil (2710). No customs line was examined in this task, therefore every product above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — corroborated only by the company's own website (garslubricants.com home page and /company-overview/), not by shipment records.
